parts.title: Swimming club

gaps.explanation_es: «We meet twice a week, on Tuesdays and Fridays».
«The lessons begin at half past five».
«You must also wear a swimming hat». Se puede comprar en la piscina por tres libras.
«The club costs twenty pounds a month». Las tres libras son del gorro.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: Good afternoon. I want to tell you about the new swimming club at Greenwood Pool.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: The club is for people aged eleven to sixteen. We meet twice a week, on Tuesdays and Fridays. The lessons begin at half past five, and last for one hour.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: You need to bring a swimming costume and a towel, of course. You must also wear a swimming hat. You can buy one at the pool for three pounds.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: The club costs twenty pounds a month. Your first lesson is free.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: Our teacher's name is Mr Lakey. That's L, A, K, E, Y. He was a swimming champion when he was younger.

segments.speaker: man
segments.text: If you want to join, please come to the pool office before Friday.

parts.rubric: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B or C). You will hear Kate talking to her friend Ben about his birthday party.

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: Hi, Kate. Are you coming to my birthday party?

segments.speaker: kate
segments.text: Of course! When is it? This Saturday?

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: No, my grandparents are visiting on Saturday. It's on Sunday afternoon.

segments.speaker: kate
segments.text: Great. Is it at your house?

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: My house is too small. We're having it at the bowling centre in town. Do you know it?

segments.speaker: kate
segments.text: Yes, it's next to the station. What time should I come?

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: We start bowling at three, but come at half past two. We can have a drink first.

segments.speaker: kate
segments.text: OK. How many people are coming?

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: I invited fifteen, but three can't come. So, twelve.

segments.speaker: kate
segments.text: What about food? Shall I bring something?

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: No, there's a café there. We'll have pizza after the game. My mum is making a chocolate cake, too.

segments.speaker: kate
segments.text: Lovely. And what would you like for a present?

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: You don't have to buy anything. But I'd love a book about space. I already have lots of games.

segments.speaker: kate
segments.text: OK! See you on Sunday.

questions.explanation_es: El sábado vienen sus abuelos: «It's on Sunday afternoon».
Su casa es muy pequeña; será en la bolera, que está al lado de la estación.
Empiezan a jugar a las tres, pero le pide que llegue «at half past two» para tomar algo antes.

questions.prompt: How many people are coming to the party?
questions.explanation_es: Invitó a quince y tres no pueden ir: «So, twelve».
«I'd love a book about space». Juegos ya tiene muchos, y la tarta la hace su madre.

parts.rubric: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear Sara talking to her friend Tom about her family. What hobby does each person have now?

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Sara, your family does lots of things, doesn't it? Does your mum still go running?

segments.speaker: sara
segments.text: Not now. She hurt her leg last year. She has started painting. She paints pictures of our garden.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: And your dad? Does he like cooking?

segments.speaker: sara
segments.text: He can't cook at all! Dad loves his bike. He rides fifty kilometres every Sunday.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: What about your brother?

segments.speaker: sara
segments.text: Leo? He goes to the river every weekend with his friends. They catch fish, but they always put them back in the water.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: And your sister? I think she likes taking photos.

segments.speaker: sara
segments.text: She did, but she sold her camera. Now she's in a band. She has a beautiful voice.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: And your grandfather?

segments.speaker: sara
segments.text: He's seventy-five, but he's outside every day with his plants. He grows tomatoes and flowers. He gives us vegetables every week.

questions.explanation_es: Ya no corre porque se hizo daño en la pierna: «She has started painting».
No sabe cocinar; «Dad loves his bike» y hace cincuenta kilómetros cada domingo.
Va al río con sus amigos: «They catch fish».
Vendió la cámara; ahora está en un grupo y «has a beautiful voice».
Está todos los días fuera con sus plantas y cultiva tomates y flores.
